description: Read legacy competitor-based keyword scores for App Store or Google Play. Difficulty and popularity are heuristics, not measured search volume or ranking probability. These are separate from the experimental Keyword analyzer. Missing store data can prevent scoring.

country.description: Two-letter country code (e.g. us, gb, de). Defaults to us.

keyword.description: The keyword or phrase to score.

platform.description: Store to score against. Defaults to ios.

name: keyword_difficulty
